criteria.statement: PlayerLifeCard.tsx's preview grid template is never derived from layout.columns/layout.rows and never Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(...))
The preview grid has at most 2 rows at every tested player count (2, 4, 6, 8)
At 8 players the preview grid is wider than tall (more columns than rows), not a ceil(sqrt(8))=3 square and not a tall stack
Exactly one preview cell renders 'me', at a fixed corner position, for the current player's own label (4-player and 8-player cases)
The preview's shape for a given player count is the same in grid-mode layout and list-mode layout
npm run test passes for PlayerLifeCard.test.tsx
